# Rokuga

> A free, native, open-source screen recorder for Mac.

Rokuga is a menu bar app with a floating recording toolbar. It records directly to a Finder folder using ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation.

## Download

Get Rokuga from the Mac App Store or install it with Homebrew. The app is free and requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later.

## Recording

- Modes: selected area, full screen, and individual window
- Video: H.264 or H.265 in MP4 or MOV, up to 5K
- Frame rates: 30 fps, 60 fps, or matched to the display
- Audio: driver-free system audio capture
- Limits: no time limit and no watermark
- Distribution: Mac App Store and Homebrew

## Languages

English, Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
